classification: systemd-oomd terminated the shared desktop cgroup during model startup

evidence.oomd_action: Killed the unit after user-manager memory pressure exceeded 50% for over 20s with reclaim activity
evidence.unit_pressure_avg10: some=90.01%, full=not reported in the OOMd entry
evidence.model_runner_at_event: Strata was still loading the GGUF and experts; server log had not reached healthy/ready; no request.json, response.json or result receipt exists
evidence.codex_server: Previous app-server PID 833954 logged until 10:17:10; after the desktop relaunched, PID 2778603 logged a missing custom tool output for the interrupted call
evidence.kernel_oom_or_nvidia_xid: No matching kernel OOM or NVIDIA Xid records in the incident window
evidence.systemd_user_service_memory_max: max; the observed event was pressure-based systemd-oomd selection, not a configured hard memory.max

root_cause: The benchmark was spawned as a child of the Codex tool turn. Its Strata server therefore shared the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app cgroup. The large mapped model working set produced sustained memory PSI; systemd-oomd killed the entire app scope, including the active Codex tool process.

mitigation.supervisor: detached transient user service in background.slice
mitigation.each_inference: one separate transient user service/cgroup in background.slice, with KillMode=control-group and OOMPolicy=stop
mitigation.durability: atomic progress.json update before dispatch; per-run preflight, request/response and receipt; unit journal persisted to each run directory
mitigation.monitoring: record run-cgroup and user-manager memory PSI; stop the isolated worker after five samples at user-manager some.avg10 or full.avg10 >= 50%; generic runner gate remains 80%/60%

confidence: high for the cgroup/OOMd termination mechanism; no evidence attributes the event to a model-quality failure or GPU driver fault
